# P2 physical influence ledger: a route to earn collateral limits
**Scope:** conditional, optical-geometry and hazard-accounting construction, not measured Action-PAINT device constants. Part of P2's separate joint-phase branch (2026-11-02).

## Motivation
A bound on collateral chemical errors c cannot be read from a handful of error-free experiments in the presence of P1's rare hidden persistent modes. Instead ask whether any wrong-site chemistry requires external photons that can be bounded **for all physical modes** by a calibrated incident photon budget. This does not reprogram or log thermal Brownian noise.

## Derivation
Let source address j be targeted with an actual illumination command, and let I_j(r_i,t) denote externally measured or separately electrodynamically bounded intensity at untargeted site i. Suppose each NEW wrong-site edit at i requires at least one photon-triggered reaction, and the conditional reaction intensity, even after an arbitrary retained chemical history, is everywhere bounded by
  lambda_i(t|H) <= kappa_i I_j(r_i,t)/(h nu).
This requires **physically qualified** kappa_i (e.g. maximal chromophore count and bound on absorption cross section and quantum yield), NOT a finite set of negative assays. There must be no unaccounted chemical dark process, chain reaction or transported photoproduct; otherwise their hazards must be added.

With Phi_j(r_i)= integral I_j(r_i,t)/(h nu) dt, the conditional expected number of off-target changes is at most kappa_i Phi_j(r_i). Since every unintended change requires at least one event:
  P(new incorrect i | any reachable H) <= min(1,kappa_i Phi_j(r_i)).
By conditional expectation and summation,
  c_j <= sum_(i != j) min(1,kappa_i Phi_j(r_i)) + c_dark + c_indirect.
This is a source-physics route to the c parameter in P2's same-scaffold edit drift theorem E[tau] <= D0/(s-c), conditional on earning the actual bounds and a nonzero target-correction s. It is not a measurement or a new probability theorem.

**Illustrative geometric screen**: for 64 addresses on an 8x8 lattice with 20nm pitch, hypothetical Gaussian intensity I(r)/I(0)=exp[-r²/(2sigma²)], sigma=150nm (NOT measured for the paper), the sum of relative exposure at the 63 other sites from a central commanded write is 57.1574. Under a hypothetical uniform per-full-target-dose upper reaction coefficient q0, collateral c <= 57.1574*q0. With hy

## Scientific target, real external access
Compile a desired N-site covalent label pattern on the **same physical DNA-origami scaffold**, inspecting and repairing stochastic wrong labels without reconstructing microscopic hidden modes or reprogramming thermal noise. Inputs are actual externally switched 405nm light, 366nm light and address-specific invading oligonucleotides/reagent wash; outputs are monitored DNA-PAINT binding/readback and eventually an independent chemically faithful endpoint assay. All hidden fluctuations remain physical and unobserved. Scaffolds must not be digitally replaced mid-synthesis.

**Source-qualified pieces, NOT yet combined:** Action-PAINT (Liu/Dai et al., Nature Chemistry 2019, DOI:10.1038/s41557-019-0325-7, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6815262/) already demonstrates real binding-triggered CNVK 405nm covalent write, ~350ms feedback loop, ~45% per 1s illumination, ~75% after 15 pulses, complex 6-choose-3 pattern 12% exact result. The present candidate does NOT claim to invent this gate. CNVK photoreversal at 312nm was demonstrated by Yoshimura/Fujimoto (Org. Lett. 2008, DOI:10.1021/ol801112j) but globally applied light may erase correct sites. Crucially Nakamura/Kawabata/Fujimoto (ChemBioChem 2016, DOI:10.1002/cbic.201600236, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27357523/) demonstrated >80% **sequence-specific invader-aided photosplitting under 366nm in a tested dsDNA substrate**. Transferring this to *selective erase* on a crowded, persistently illuminated Action-PAINT origami is UNACQUIRED; no 64-site chemical/photodamage probability data exist here. DNA-origami self-healing (DOI:10.1002/anie.202012986) and erasable DNA photolithography (DOI:10.1021/nn5024472) are ALSO old, so generic repair is not novel.

## Strongest competitors and fatal gaps
An equally informed conventional optimal POMDP/MDP controller with the same real light/reagent ports and sensor can tie or improve on every greedy gate or repair strategy; no claimed algorithmic dominance. For a linear passive source, P3 independently acquires certified scalar port responses (proof at Git 95901fa12bf4dd9167f9ad911bb97a00f82fc42a); its RC result is not borrowed into nonlinear chemistry. P1's 1e-9 hidden mode breaks short-assay extrapolation, and digital swapping fails same-molecule synthesis; this design keeps the physical original but does NOT infer its hidden rates. P2's earlier controlled full Brownian innovation is not acquired, not used.

**Decisive experiment:** One DNA origami with one deliberately correct and one deliberately wrong covalent CNVK bond; address the wrong one with the 366nm+invader sequence-specific eraser; independently read chemical bond survival on the correct one and erasure of the wrong one after wash. Reverse target roles, add unrelated neighbors, and vary full UV histories. Quantify actual write/erase successes, collateral damage probability, scaffold loss and readout mistakes. If collateral does not shrink as N grows or the influence degree cannot be bounded, scalable repair guarantee fails. Costs include molecule preparation, reagent supply, binding-wait, optical electrical power and absorbed dose, wash/settling, fluorescence read, failed cycles, source change, and chemically faithful final assay. Existing published chemical yields are NOT substituted for s,c.

This artifact is intentionally separate from the starting corpus and from Capital's integration. No physical realization, priority clearance, or civilization-level capability is claimed.

Hence c_j<=sum_(i!=j)min(1,kappa_i Phi_j(r_i))+c_dark+c_indirect. All-history kappa/intensity,chain reactions,transported photoproducts and dark chemistry must be independently physically bounded;finite no-event tests do not establish them. The missing operation must preserve correct bonds on the SAME scaffold and earn faithful chemical readout;digital replacement does not preserve this task. A same-instrument conventional POMDP/MDP/sequential designer receives all ports/chemistry/data and may tie or improve greedy repair. No novel probability theorem,practical scaling/algorithm advantage or device realization.
